newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Zhenghong Feed Co to offer 50 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: China's Zhenghong Feed Co to offer 50 mln A shares.

text.p: Hunan Zhenghong Feed Co Ltd has applied to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for an offer of 50 million A shares and to list the stock in Shenzhen this year, a company official said on Wednesday.
Based in the city of Yueyang in central Hunan province, the firm processes poultry and pig feeds, the official told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.
Shenzhen Great Eagle Securities Co Ltd has been named as the offer's main underwriter, the official said.
Zhenghong, which has capacity to produce 250,000-300,000 tonnes of feeds annually, aims to use the A share proceeds to expand its main business, he said.
Zhenghong has total share capital of 130 million shares owned by state institutions and estimates its 1996 net profits at about 46 million yuan versus 40.11 million yuan recorded in 1995.
The firm is also one of the 33 domestic enterprises named on Wednesday as candidates for B share listings by the Securities Commission of the State Council.
The official said the company had no immediate plans to offer B shares.
